description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver subclass RequestPinShortcutResultReceiver used to handle shortcut result broadcasts in an Android application. It contains an onReceive method that displays a toast message when a result is received.

classes.name: RequestPinShortcutResultReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles the result of pinning shortcuts in the Android launcher, displaying a toast message when triggered.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the broadcast intent; in this case, it calls a method to display a toast message indicating the result was received.
